(information)
Advanced Opt-out add-on applied!

We noticed that the Messaging Service
 you used to register this Campaign with is using Twilio’s Advanced Opt-out add-on, so we used this information to automatically fill out the details related to Opt Out and Help for your Campaign registration.

To view or manage your Advanced Opt-out settings, please go to Messaging Service - Opt-Out Management

How do end-users consent to receive messages?
A person starts by texting HELP or their own question to +13464853328. The public invitation and disclosures are at https://www.machinesandcloud.com/sms-terms.html#platform-sms. Only direct replies about that person's Machines & Cloud product, onboarding or account-support question are permitted. The inbound message is retained as consent evidence for that exchange; it does not authorize recurring engagement. Calling, emailing, signup, booking or providing a phone number is not SMS consent. No website checkbox, purchased list or verbal opt-in is used. Message frequency varies with the messages the person sends. Message and data rates may apply. HELP or AYUDA provides help; STOP, ALTO or PARAR ends texts. START, UNSTOP or EMPEZAR only removes an earlier block and does not subscribe the person to recurring texts. Terms: https://www.machinesandcloud.com/sms-terms.html. Privacy: https://www.machinesandcloud.com/privacy-policy.html#sms. Public CTA: https://www.machinesandcloud.com/sms-terms.html#platform-sms.
